name: overnight-no-taker-silent
about: An overnight run no runner can take expires at 07:00 without a note (#505; it was noted on every night it missed, #416). The approver schedules tonight's run; the only runner asks for regression runs but has no voice capability (the overnight suite needs emulator, gpu, voice), so the run is never claimed. At 07:00 nothing reaches #loop and there is no regression_missed: loopd cancels the run (via expired), so it does not carry over, and the next night is as quiet.
